booking.title: Booking & cancellations
items: View or reschedule your bookings from the Bookings tab.
Cancellations may be subject to the provider’s policy.
Contact the provider if you need to adjust timing.

payments.title: Payments & payouts
items: Prices are shown before you confirm a booking.
Providers receive payouts after service completion.
Refunds follow the cancellation rules.

account.title: Account & profile
items: Keep your profile updated for better matches.
Use Reset Password if you can’t log in.
You can change language from Profile settings.

deleteAccount.title: How to delete my account
items: Go to your Profile page and scroll to the bottom.
Click on 'Delete Account' button.
Enter your password to confirm your identity.
Click 'Delete Account' to permanently delete your account.
All your data will be permanently deleted including your profile, bookings history, reviews, and messages.
This action cannot be undone.
You can also delete your account by reaching out to our Help Center at 60azsazs@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
items: Read our full Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your data.
View Privacy Policy

safety.title: Safety & disputes
items: Use in-app chat to keep records of agreements.
Report issues promptly to help resolve disputes.
Only meet in safe, agreed locations.

messaging.title: Messaging
items: Chat is available after a booking is created.
Keep conversations respectful and on-topic.
Notifications can be managed in Profile preferences.

reportContact.title: File a Complaint about Inappropriate Content
items: If you encounter inappropriate content, use the Complaint button on the content or user's profile.
You can also block users who violate community guidelines.
For urgent safety concerns, contact us directly at 60azsazs@gmail.com.
All complaints are reviewed within 24 hours.
